heading.title: Third Division · Part I · Applications in Specified Cases

article.title: Ninety days.
article.content:
Article120Ninety days.

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
Under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908), to have the legalrepresentative of a deceased plaintiff or appellant or of a deceased defendant or respondent, made a party.
Period of limitationNinety days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of death of the plaintiff, appellant, defendant or respondent, as the case may be.
